text.title: API Gateway Patterns & Technology Selection Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable input signals to a conclusion that references a rule from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Do ALL Applies-If conditions hold AND NO Skip-If condition triggers?

branch.question: Is a named single accountable owner present (not 'team' / 'we' / 'us')?
Is the source-of-truth for required inputs reachable and citable?

conclusion.verdict: apply the methodology; produce the decision-record artefact and validate it.
defer until source-of-truth is reachable; paraphrased substitutes are worse than skipping.
block; require a single named owner before any further work.
do not apply this methodology in this context; route to the correct one or skip.

text.example: Applies-If holds, Skip-If clear → owner is a named human → inputs reachable → produce + validate the decision-record artefact.

section.title: Operational review tree (merged from dev/api-gateway-patterns)
section.p: Once the pattern and product are chosen, review an existing gateway config or PR diff against this second tree. Apply top to bottom; the first matching branch is decisive, and when several match, fix in the order listed because later fixes usually depend on earlier ones.

decision-tree.root-question: Which observable signal best describes the artefact under review?

conclusion.verdict: move the logic into a BFF; reserve plugins for auth, rate-limit, tracing and CORS.
rate-limit by consumer or X-Forwarded-For; never by the proxy's remote IP.
generate X-Request-ID at ingress, propagate downstream, log it at every hop.
reduce gateway below client and upstream below gateway with 50% headroom.
configure breakers per upstream service; one slow service must not kill all routes.
manage via deck / Terraform / Argo CD; reject hand-run reloads and UI edits.
finish on one mode; migrating DB to DB-less while serving traffic loses state.
fan out in parallel with a per-service timeout and degrade partially instead of failing the composition.
use a direct reverse proxy; a gateway adds operational overhead for no gain.
signal does not match; route to a different methodology or proceed without this one.
